items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the property of being unramified for a morphism of algebraic stacks is preserved under base change and under composition (author lemma at source lines 8419-8426, label lemma-permanence-unramified). The proof (source lines 8428-8447) reformulates unramifiedness as a property of the diagonal, which makes the base change case immediate because the diagonal of a base change is a base change of the diagonal, and proves the composition case by passing to a smooth presentation (proof lines 8429-8445). The reformulation through the diagonal and the presentation argument for the composite are the content. H2.
